svg.aria-label: An annotated QSL unit: (1) the header names the language and edition, (2) the profile says which part of the language the rules use, (3) the model line imports a domain package by exact identity and digest, (4) invariants must hold for every object, (5) a post rule compares a value after an operation with its value before.
